style.layout: kinetic-type launch film with product screenshots on tilted 3D planes; centred headlines dominate, UI windows appear as enlarged cards or washed-out background props
style.background: white #FFFFFF fading to a blue radial glow #4FA0FF at the bottom; saturated blue #1E6BFF and deep navy #04366B radial fields; one black #0A0A0A end card
style.typography: Inter/SF-style grotesque, medium weight, sentence case, black #111111 on white and white on blue; keyword accent in blue #2F7BFF or bold weight; single words up to 1/4 frame height; bracket glyphs as framing device
style.camera_motion: dashboards fly in on a perspective plane with slight drift; kinetic text slides with directional motion blur; no zoom into live UI
style.transitions: 10 hard cuts plus many blur dissolves and light-leak wipes not counted by the detector; blue field to white field alternation
style.ui_highlight: UI shown as whole windows enlarged on a glow, greyed-out when representing the problem; one arrow cursor click on Save Workflow; no spotlight or zoom ring
style.text_animation: typewriter with caret at open and close, directional motion-blur slides, keyword colour/weight swap, tracking-out letters, brackets closing around a phrase
style.pacing_frames: 11 detected shots avg 260 frames, min 59, max 579; many 45-90 frame text beats inside the long shots
style.cursor_or_hand: small black arrow cursor once (Save Workflow click); otherwise none
style.real_ui_vs_motion: real product screenshots composited in motion design; no screen recording; UI partially blurred for mood
style.audio: audio stream present (music plus voiceover-style pacing)
style.three_beat: yes: problem (frames 0-298) -> product reveal and feature beats (frames 298-2353) -> payoff They close tickets / We Eliminate them + logo (frames 2353-2858)

verdict: Kinetic-typography SaaS launch: big centred words with motion blur carry the story, screenshots on tilted planes provide proof (sheet_1, 3, 5).
Two-tone world: white with a blue bottom glow for calm beats, saturated/navy blue radial fields for emphasis, one black tagline end card.
Problem beat greys out competitor-style windows in the margins; solution beat lights the dashboard with a glow on saturated blue.
Slow detected cut rate (11 shots in 95 s) but dense internal text beats; heavy blur transitions make it feel faster than the counts suggest.

Useful lessons: bracket framing device, typed caret opener and closer, keyword colour swap inside a sentence, glowing dashboard on a tilted plane; the 95 s length and repeated word-only beats are too slow for a 30 s demo.

evidence.method: ffmpeg select=gt(scene,0.3) + contact sheets fps=1/step tile 4x3 + visual inspection (sheets 1, 3, 5 inspected)
